This implies that vorinostat may influence RVH-421 through the modulation of TRPM2, a channel involved in cellular signaling. While the exact mechanism linking KB 3-1 to RVH-421 remains unclear, the shared pathway to RVH-421 suggests a possible functional relationship. The evidence highlights the role of histone deacetylase inhibitors in modulating cellular signaling pathways, potentially influencing RVH-421 through the regulation of ion channels and other molecular targets.
